title: EntitlementRevokedEvent
description: Emitted when a capability entitlement is revoked or expires (ADR-0016 §23-24 -- capability entitlement has an independent lifecycle from identity and membership; revoking one capability, e.g. ERP, does not revoke unrelated ones, e.g. Trade/CMS/Pulse, unless policy explicitly couples them). This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

capability_key.description: The implementation-neutral capability this entitlement grants (e.g. baobab_erp, baobab_trade).

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
